courses.title: Introduction to React & Tailwind CSS
courses.description: Learn how to build beautiful, modern, and responsive user interfaces using React and Tailwind CSS. We will cover components, state, hooks, and clean utility design.

lectures.title: 1.2 Setting Up Your Environment
lectures.contentUrl: Open your terminal and run 'npm create vite@latest' to bootstrap a clean workspace. Use CSS grid and flexbox inside Tailwind to arrange containers.

lectures.title: 2.1 Utility-First Principles
lectures.contentUrl: We prioritize utility-first design: no custom styles or random paddings, use consistent margins like 'p-6', 'space-y-4', and soft slate-colored backgrounds.

courses.title: Advanced Java Programming & Spring Boot
courses.description: Deep dive into Java 21 features, Spring Framework 6, JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security with JWT tokens, and building scalable production backends.

modules.title: Module 1: Java 21 Virtual Threads & Structured Concurrency

lectures.title: 1.1 Java 21 Overview
lectures.contentUrl: Java 21 introduces virtual threads (Project Loom) that simplify writing high-throughput, concurrent applications.

assignments.title: Assignment 1: Responsive Card Layout
assignments.description: Design a responsive profile card using React functional components and Tailwind CSS utility classes. Submit a live website URL or source code path.

assignments.title: Module 1 Quiz: React Basics
assignments.description: Complete the questions: 1. What hook manages state? 2. What are the key benefits of virtual DOM?
